patches_added.name: Toolbar Buttons
patches_added.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Adds six hotkey buttons too, each typing a string you set in Flexboard's settings — they only appear once you have filled one in.

patches_removed.name: Select All Button
patches_removed.description: Add a Select all button to the toolbar above the keyboard. One tap selects everything in the text field, without opening Gboard's text editing panel first.

patches_modified.name: Clean main UI
patches_modified.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, keeps the connect/create/join buttons on top, and stops them from being auto-hidden. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches_added.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_added.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's file-extension and scheme/mimeType intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_added.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_added.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's scheme/mimeType/host/pathPattern intent-filter data (action and category tags kept) so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_added.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_added.description: Makes the number of icons on the toolbar above the keyboard adjustable, from Gboard's own settings. Anything past the limit stays in the overflow menu.

patches_added.name: Select All Button
patches_added.description: Add a Select all button to the toolbar above the keyboard. One tap selects everything in the text field, without opening Gboard's text editing panel first.

patches_modified.name: Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage
patches_modified.description: Imports device subtitle files into Nuvio's ExoPlayer subtitle menu without rebuilding active playback.

patches_modified.name: Library Mode Focus Fix
patches_modified.description: Returns Library focus to the previously selected Saved or Cloud mode.

patches_modified.name: Local Downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads selected direct movie and episode sources to local storage for exact local playback.

patches_modified.name: Local Media
patches_modified.description: Adds Library > Storage playback, folder selection, and same-basename sidecar subtitles for local video files.

patches_modified.name: Mark SDH Subtitles
patches_modified.description: Marks explicitly labelled SDH tracks and detected English SDH subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Random Episode
patches_modified.description: Adds Morphe > Detail Page > Show Random Episode Button and random series playback.

patches_modified.name: Rating Visibility
patches_modified.description: Adds Settings > Morphe > Ratings with independent overall and episode rating controls.

patches_modified.name: Remove SDH Annotations
patches_modified.description: Adds Settings → Morphe → Subtitles to normalize music symbols and remove SDH annotations from Media3 subtitles.

patches_modified.name: Restore Source Selection
patches_modified.description: Returns the source picker to the source played before leaving the player.

patches_modified.name: Side-by-side installation
patches_modified.description: Installs the patched app separately as Nuvio Morphe instead of replacing NuvioTV.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Changes the application package name in AndroidManifest.xml (e.g. for media display whitelist compatibility or cloning).

patches_added.name: Clean main UI
patches_added.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, keeps the connect/create/join buttons on top, and stops them from being auto-hidden. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches_added.name: Skip splash screen
patches_added.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely. Also restores the storage-permission request and local media scan that the splash screen normally performs, so the Apps/Photo/Video tabs still load.

patches_added.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_added.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's file-extension and scheme/mimeType intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_added.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_added.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's scheme/mimeType/host/pathPattern intent-filter data (action and category tags kept) so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_modified.name: Price history charts
patches_modified.description: Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.

patches_modified.name: Price history charts
patches_modified.description: Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy.

patches_added.name: Main activity orientation fix
patches_added.description: Changes PetalMapsActivity's screenOrientation from "behind" to "unspecified", allowing the app to rotate freely.

patches_modified.name: Huawei login fix
patches_modified.description: Forces HMS Core sign-in path (a.g) in AccountFactory. Requires HMS Core installed. Disable if HMS Core is not available.

patches_added.name: Main activity orientation fix
patches_added.description: Changes PetalMapsActivity's screenOrientation from "behind" to "unspecified", allowing the app to rotate freely.

patches_modified.name: Huawei login fix
patches_modified.description: Forces HMS Core sign-in path (a.g) in AccountFactory. Requires HMS Core installed. Disable if HMS Core is not available.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes all banner ads, interstitial ads, open app ads, and enables permanent ad-free status.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, the playlist bar, the floating event badge, AI-generated posts, paid partnership and promotional content, the account, bulletin-board and other inserted cards, posts from verified accounts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_added.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_added.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after you take a screenshot, and stops it from watching for screenshots in the first place on the screens where that is possible. Can be turned back off from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a 'Copy direct link' option to the pin menu to copy a link under the direct CDN media format instead of the standard Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) pins from the home feed and from search/related/board feeds. Also carries two more filters turned on from the Morphe settings screen: "Hide product pins", off by default, and "Hide board modules in search" (sponsored carousel and featured boards), on by default. They ride on the same three hooks because the search landing page is delivered by the very same feed responses.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Immediately closes the "confirm your email" modal (and similar ones: connect Google, etc.) if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download images and videos from already loaded pins. Streaming-only videos are reported and skipped.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a 'Download video' option to the pin menu for video pins, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_modified.description: Hooks the '+' (create Pin) navigation bar button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_modified.description: Hooks the notifications button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_modified.description: Hooks the search button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hooks the '+' (create) and inbox/notifications buttons in the home feed header: hidden if the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section both on the search screen and in the carousel below the search bar. It does not prevent Pinterest from logging searches (server-side), but stops them from being shown anywhere in the app.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings entry
patches_modified.description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches_modified.description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches_modified.description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces ‘limit ad tracking’, disabling ad tracking without causing the app to crash.

patches_modified.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches_modified.description: It adds the ‘Set as wallpaper’ option to the pin menu, which downloads uses the image and sets it as the device’s wallpaper.

patches_added.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_added.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK: init() becomes a no-op and isStopped() always returns true, so no install, event or uninstall data is transmitted.

patches_added.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_added.description: Removes the Google Engage broadcast receiver, so Pinterest cannot publish your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_added.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_added.description: Makes the periodic Google Engage job fail, so no content recommendation is ever published to Google even when the job is scheduled from outside the manifest.

patches_added.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_added.description: Turns off the advertising and telemetry SDKs Pinterest embeds — Google Ads (AdMob), Bugsnag crash reporting, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance and the Android Privacy Sandbox ad APIs — and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications are unaffected.

patches_added.name: Hide ad views
patches_added.description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views (text ad cards, promoted closeup action bars, sponsored board headers) so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch in the Morphe settings screen.

patches_added.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_added.description: Hooks the '+' (create) and inbox/notifications buttons in the home feed header: hidden if the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_added.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_added.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after you take a screenshot, and stops it from watching for screenshots in the first place on the screens where that is possible. Can be turned back off from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_added.name: Sanitize copied links
patches_added.description: Resolves the pin.it short link that "Copy link" puts on the clipboard — its slug identifies who shared it — to the plain pin link, and strips tracking parameters. Can be turned off from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_added.name: Sanitize shared links
patches_added.description: Strips UTM and click-ID tracking parameters from the link Pinterest puts on the Android share sheet, and resolves pin.it short links — whose slug identifies who shared it — to the plain pin link. Can be turned off from the Morphe settings screen.
